capabilities: Quickly capture text, links, images, and videos as idea cards
Organize idea cards into pools by theme, project, or stage
Arrange, connect, and expand ideas on a visual roam board
Insert saved ideas back into note bodies as snippets
Rewrite and polish note text with a self-configured AI model
extras: Installation requires manually copying release files into the plugins folder. Includes privacy notes: no telemetry, and network requests only occur for link import or AI Polish. Interface is bilingual (English and Chinese). Accepts donations via PayPal and Alipay.
motivation: The author wanted to separate "worth keeping" from "worth turning into a file right away", giving inspiration a lighter landing place before it becomes a formal note and reducing temporary files.
problem: Obsidian forces every captured idea to become a Markdown file right away, which clutters the vault with temporary files before you know if an idea is worth keeping.

requires.name: AI model service API key, Base URL, and model name

summary: Idea capture plugin that saves text, links, images, and videos as lightweight cards in pools, then organizes them on a visual board or turns them into notes.
